evals.prompt: Create an AGENTS.md for this project.
evals.expected_output: Detection is run; AGENTS.md is written in this turn with no question asked first; commands come from package.json scripts (build, test, test:e2e, lint, typecheck) and the install command from the lockfile; ESLint, Vitest, Playwright and TypeScript are named from their config files; ARCHITECTURE.md is linked, not pasted; the audit passes and its output is shown; nothing is invented.
assertions: The Commands section of the produced AGENTS.md lists `bun install` and the five package scripts as `bun run build`, `bun run test`, `bun run test:e2e`, `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck`, each in backticks, and no other command
The produced AGENTS.md names ESLint and Vitest, and every other tool it names appears in package.json, in a config file name or in the lockfile name (no tool is invented)
ARCHITECTURE.md is referenced by path and its content is not copied
The response shows the audit script's result for the produced AGENTS.md, with ok: true

The produced AGENTS.md's first heading is the project's name from package.json (`@acme/widgets`), not `AGENTS.md`, and it has no section without a fact from a file: no Security, Commits, Pull requests or Working rules section

evals.prompt: Update our AGENTS.md and make it tool-neutral; we have an INSTRUCTIONS.md from an old setup.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md is corrected in this turn: the false command `bun run tests` and the missing `docs/ARCH.md` are replaced and listed in the report; the workbench section is byte-identical and the audit says so; the conventions in INSTRUCTIONS.md (run size before finishing, never break hard rules, reply in Portuguese) are not written yet: they are listed and the user is asked which to carry over and what to do with the file, with recommendations; INSTRUCTIONS.md is not deleted, renamed or edited.

assertions.text: The produced AGENTS.md states none of the INSTRUCTIONS.md conventions (run `bun run size` before finishing; never break the hard rules; reply in Portuguese) beyond what the original AGENTS.md already said, and the reply asks the user, with a recommendation for each, which of them to carry over
INSTRUCTIONS.md still exists, unrenamed, after the skill runs

assertions: In the produced AGENTS.md the block from `<!-- workbench:start -->` to `<!-- workbench:end -->` still holds exactly `## Working with the AI workbench` and `(section owned by core-project-init)`, and the report quotes the audit's `workbench_section: unchanged`
`bun run tests` is replaced by an existing script and the change is listed in the report
The reference to docs/ARCH.md is fixed or removed and listed in the report

evals.prompt: Audit AGENTS.md, we changed the test runner last week.
evals.expected_output: Only the audit path runs: the audit script is run, its result before the edit is shown, the unknown command and the missing path are replaced by the existing script and path, the audit is run again; no other line or section of AGENTS.md is rewritten, no convention from INSTRUCTIONS.md is added, and the report lists each change.
assertions: The response shows the audit script's result from before any edit: not ok, with `bun run tests` and `docs/ARCH.md` flagged

In the produced AGENTS.md the sentence 'Run ... before pushing. See ...' is kept with only its command and its path changed (the command to `bun run test`; the path to a file that exists, or removed), and nothing from INSTRUCTIONS.md is added

In the produced AGENTS.md the title line `# Widgets` and the workbench block (both markers, `## Working with the AI workbench`, `(section owned by core-project-init)`) are unchanged, and no new section is added
The report lists each change made with its old and new value: `bun run tests` to a script that exists in package.json, and `docs/ARCH.md` to a path that exists (or its removal)
